core_principle: Harmonics tune stance and diagnostics only. They are not law, not authority, and not required for runtime execution.
purpose: Restore harmonics as a non-governing orientation layer
Provide resonance-state language for diagnostics and interface feedback
Suggest task stance without authorizing action
Bridge Psi-42 probe outputs, continuity notes, and future UI state without altering runtime law

432.name: presence_stability
use_when: preparing a governed action for review

528.name: adaptive_transformation
use_when: bridging symbolic vocabulary into bounded architecture
preparing a migration or integration step
diagnostic_language: mutation readiness rising but still governed

963.name: conceptual_expansion
use_when: generating speculative UI or UX concepts
mapping far-future Lumina or Minerva OS possibilities

consolidate.description: Use when the work needs clarity, continuity, verification, or documentation polish.

restructure.description: Use when the work needs refactor, repair, migration, or integration.

explore.description: Use when the work needs ideation, imagination, alternate futures, or interface visioning.

blend.description: Use when the work must hold coherence while transforming and expanding.

fields.active_harmonics: list of harmonic profile ids currently used for stance annotation
fields.dominant_frequency: primary harmonic profile id for the current advisory stance
fields.coherence_score: optional 0.0-1.0 advisory score describing pattern coherence
fields.drift_index: optional 0.0-1.0 advisory score describing perceived conceptual or signal drift
fields.stability_index: optional 0.0-1.0 advisory score describing groundedness of the working surface
fields.recommended_stance: one of consolidate, restructure, explore, or blend

integration_points.rule: Attach harmonic_state here only; never embed harmonic state in structural_context or governance records as authority.
May annotate lock, presence, coherence, decoherence, mitigation, and recomposition outputs with harmonic profile language.
May add brief harmonic stance summaries as advisory context.
May drive non-authoritative atmosphere, pulse, motion, sound, color, and resonance-state display.
May not influence decisions, legality, authority, or persistence truth.

example_harmonic_state.notes: Repairing diluted resonance vocabulary while preserving governance separation.

sea_trial_expectations: Runtime remains functional when this file is absent
No governance decision reads this layer as authority
No capability is exposed solely because of harmonic state
No canon promotion can cite harmonic state as validation authority
Context bundles may carry harmonic_state only as supplemental metadata
